label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. Three distinct reliable first-hand sources report safe use over at least five years (E2, E3 and E4); no direct or class 1–4 indirect evidence is recorded, and all evidence-log items have been registered. The national criteria check passes, including that no past accident is recorded inside this area.
flags: The desk study notes the nearest database accident is within 1 km, not inside the area; it does not trigger the inside-area clearance rule.
The community-meeting zone flag and survey-priority rank indicate where to visit, not evidence about EO presence.
E2 reports weekly family use but does not state how long that use has continued; E3 and E4 independently meet the five-year safe-use duration.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
3 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E2; E3; E4); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: does not know the land inside it.
E1.note: The informant explicitly lacks knowledge of the land, so this says nothing about EO presence or absence in the area.

E2.quote: families use land in the area every week.
E2.note: A local first-hand source reports regular land use and no recorded find or accident during her 14 years in office, supporting absence; the duration of the families’ use itself is not stated.

E3.quote: has cut firewood and timber in the area every year for the past 5 years
E3.note: The woodcutter is a first-hand user and reports five years of recurring activity without finding anything or hearing of an accident, supporting safe use over the required period.

E4.quote: We have walked the trail across this land to the school for 21 years.
E4.note: The teacher is a first-hand user and reports 21 years of traversing the area without any find or injury, supporting safe use over time.
